lesson.meaning: Something or someone you know well, or recognize easily.
examples: That face looks familiar, but I can't quite remember where I know him from.
Are you familiar with our company's new expense reporting system?
During the meeting, the CEO mentioned some familiar challenges facing the industry.
It's helpful to be familiar with the client's background before our presentation.
The project manager is very familiar with the technical details of this software.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of your 'family' - you know your family very well! So, 'familiar' means well-known.
